# axa

> Small shared library for services built directly on Axum. A library, not a framework: `main.rs` stays ordinary Axum and
> calls into this crate, with no lifecycle hooks, route macros, or generated code. sqlx is
> the preferred way to reach a database. Version 0.9.1, Rust 1.97 or newer.

## Docs

- [README](README.md): why it exists, install, quick start, what it provides

- [Changelog](CHANGELOG.md): changes by version

## Modules

- [boot](src/boot.rs): Test boot helpers, including `TestApp`
- [cli](src/cli.rs): The shared command line
- [conditional](src/conditional.rs): `ETag`, `304`, and `If-Match`, as RFC 9110 has them
- [config](src/config.rs): Configuration from the process environment
- [context](src/context.rs): `AppContext`, plain Axum state
- [db](src/db.rs): Database helpers for the context
- [error](src/error.rs): The error type and its HTTP mapping
- [extract](src/extract.rs): Extractors that reject with a problem saying what was wrong
- [format](src/format.rs): Response helpers
- [health](src/health.rs): Health routes
- [logger](src/logger.rs): Logging setup, `init` and `init_with`
- [middleware](src/middleware.rs): The standard HTTP middleware stack
- [prelude](src/prelude.rs): Common imports
- [queue](src/queue.rs): The Postgres job queue, over `axa-postgres-job-queue` (feature `queue`)
- [routes](src/routes.rs): Route tables that become an ordinary `Router`
- [server](src/server.rs): Serving, connection limits, and graceful shutdown
- [store](src/store.rs): Shared in-process store
- [task](src/task.rs): Command-line tasks
- [worker](src/worker.rs): Background jobs

## Crates

- [axa-diesel](crates/axa-diesel/README.md) (feature `diesel`): Diesel pooling, migrations, and test resets for Axum services, in pure Rust.
- [axa-environment](crates/axa-environment/README.md) (always included): Which environment a service runs in, read one way, with no dependencies.
- [axa-keycloak-auth](crates/axa-keycloak-auth/README.md) (feature `keycloak`): Keycloak bearer authentication and ABAC enforcement for Axum services.
- [axa-openapi-docs](crates/axa-openapi-docs/README.md) (feature `openapi`): Serve OpenAPI documents and a pinned Swagger UI from Axum services.
- [axa-opentelemetry](crates/axa-opentelemetry/README.md) (feature `opentelemetry`): OTLP export of traces and request metrics for Axum services.
- [axa-transactional-outbox](crates/axa-transactional-outbox/README.md) (feature `outbox`, and `outbox-encryption` to seal payloads at rest): A transactional outbox and relay on Postgres for Axum services, that keeps a record of what it delivered and refused.
- [axa-postgres-job-queue](crates/axa-postgres-job-queue/README.md) (feature `queue`): A Postgres job queue, worker pool, and recurring schedules for Axum services.
- [axa-cursor-pagination](crates/axa-cursor-pagination/README.md) (feature `cursor-pagination`): Signed cursor pagination with Link rel=next and no total, and LIKE escaping, for Axum services.
- [axa-paseto-auth](crates/axa-paseto-auth/README.md) (feature `paseto`): PASETO bearer authentication and ABAC enforcement for Axum services.
- [axa-problem-details-for-http-apis](crates/axa-problem-details-for-http-apis/README.md) (always included): RFC 9457 problem details responses for Axum services.
- [axa-prometheus-metrics](crates/axa-prometheus-metrics/README.md) (feature `prometheus`): Prometheus text exposition for Axum services.
- [axa-redis-cache](crates/axa-redis-cache/README.md) (feature `redis`): A Redis cache with mandatory expiry for Axum services.
- [axa-seaorm](crates/axa-seaorm/README.md) (feature `sea-orm`): SeaORM connections, migration helpers, and model errors for Axum services, with an easy path from Loco.
- [axa-web-session](crates/axa-web-session/README.md) (feature `session`): Web sessions for Axum services over axum_session, with safe defaults.
- [axa-sqlx](crates/axa-sqlx/README.md) (feature `sqlx`): PostgreSQL pooling, migrations, and test resets over sqlx for Axum services.
- [axa-tera-templates](crates/axa-tera-templates/README.md) (feature `tera`): Tera templates with safe escaping and generic errors for Axum services.
- [axa-test](crates/axa-test/README.md) (a dev-dependency, not a feature): Request-level test helpers for axa services, built on axum-test.
- [axa-tracing](crates/axa-tracing/README.md) (feature `tracing`): Redaction, request tracking, and asynchronous diagnostics over tracing for Axum services.
- [axa-idempotency-key](crates/axa-idempotency-key/README.md) (feature `idempotency`): Idempotency-Key handling over Postgres for Axum services.
- [axa-request-rate-limit](crates/axa-request-rate-limit/README.md) (feature `ratelimit`): In-process request limits, per client or per key, and failed-login lockout for Axum services.
- [axa-accepts-version-negotiation](crates/axa-accepts-version-negotiation/README.md) (feature `versioning`): Header-based API version negotiation for Axum services.
